name: Vex
notes: Casts go one at a time: a cast takes effect as it starts and then keeps Vex busy for its cast time (no other cast, no attack) via one busy_until in the state, per the dossier's stated cast times (Q 0.15 s, W 0.25 s, E 0.25 s, R's initial cast 0.25 s).

Shadow Surge (R) opens the fight: the initial missile lands as its 0.25 s cast starts and marks the dummy (it counts as an enemy champion); once that cast time passes, the recast fires immediately with no cast time (the wiki lists the recast's cast time as 'None') for the larger mark-consume damage.

R's cooldown starts post-effect of the initial cast (at the moment the initial missile lands), but at 100-140 s it is never ready again inside the fight, so only the opening cast-and-recast sequence is modeled.

Mistral Bolt (Q), Personal Space (W) and Looming Darkness (E) are each cast as soon as they are off cooldown and Vex is not already busy with another cast; each deals its damage at the moment of cast (Personal Space's own text says the scream and its damage happen before the cast time finishes) and then keeps Vex busy for its own cast time.

Doom 'n Gloom (P) contributes nothing: Gloom only marks enemies that dash or blink, the stationary dummy never does either, so neither the detonation bonus damage nor Doom's cooldown refunds are ever reachable, per the dossier's resolution.
Looming Darkness's cooldown is taken as the wiki's and ddragon's flat 12 s at every rank, over the bin's conflicting flat 13 s.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here plausibly runs a level-16 Vex out of mana inside a 15 s fight.
Basic attacks fill every gap between casts since Vex is a ranged auto-attacker with no on-hit or attack-speed component in her kit; a cast with a cast time holds the next attack back to when it ends.
